# ISiloIncentivesController

## ISiloIncentivesController
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/silo/ISiloIncentivesController.sol)


### Functions
#### claimRewards

Claims reward for an user to the desired address, on all the assets of the lending pool,
accumulating the pending rewards


```solidity
function claimRewards(address _to) external returns (AccruedRewards[] memory accruedRewards);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_to`|`address`|Address that will be receiving the rewards|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`accruedRewards`|`AccruedRewards[]`|accruedRewards|
